pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.4: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.9: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:1.12.1: yā pana bhikkhunī tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ careyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:2.6: yassa vijite viharati taṃ ṭhapetvā aññassa raṭṭhe.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:2.8: tasmiṃ magge corānaṃ niviṭṭhokāso dissati bhuttokāso dissati ṭhitokāso dissati nisinnokāso dissati nipannokāso dissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:2.10: tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti viluttā dissanti ākoṭitā dissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:2.14: kukkuṭasaṃpāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc38:2.15: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
